lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and vertical columns that follow the body curvature.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features run horizontally along the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller high-luminance blobs is visible across the entire surface of the pectoral fin in the lower foreground.
